title: 175 common adjective and preposition pairs
description: 175 common adjective and preposition pairs such as afraid of, good at, interested in and proud of, with Vietnamese meanings and examples.
source: Written by the Alavo team. Adjective and preposition pairs chosen by hand from everyday use, kept when Longman (LDOCE) shows the pattern for the adjective; definitions paraphrase LDOCE; translations and examples are original.
